project.name: MAX
project.title: Development of a Digital Mental Health and Psychological Support System for Students in Higher Education

phases.outcome: Foundation: a student can sign up pseudonymously and see a themed, translated shell
exitGates: Auth works end to end with Better Auth and Drizzle on Neon
Design tokens defined; no hex value outside globals.css
npm run check passes with a real exit code

phases.outcome: The companion works and is safe
exitGates: Streaming chat with rolling memory and a renameable companion
Golden test set of 40+ messages passes, including Hinglish crisis phrasing
Crisis path renders the helpline card without calling the model
Output guard blocks diagnosis, medication and dependence patterns
PHQ-9, GAD-7 and CBI score and band correctly against known vectors
Mood check-in, trend and journal ship
Resource library covers all six named conditions in both languages

phases.outcome: Journeys, PWA and the rural performance budget
exitGates: One journey per condition, five to seven days each
First-load JS under 150 KB gzipped, enforced by check
Offline shell serves resources, journeys and past journal entries
Lighthouse mobile run recorded in plans/completed/

phases.outcome: Institution layer, referral directory and report evidence
exitGates: Campus dashboard returns aggregates only, minimum cohort size 10 enforced by test
Referral directory ships with verified helpline numbers
Data export and hard delete work
Screenshots and metrics collected for the report

todo.title: Scaffold the Next.js application inside the harness
acceptance: Tailwind tokens file exists and is the only place hex values appear
npm run check runs lint, typecheck, test and the bundle budget

todo.title: Stand up the safety module and its golden test set
acceptance: classifyRisk covers English, Hindi and romanised Hinglish deterministically
Model pass failure falls back to the deterministic result, never open
40+ labelled cases including hard negatives that must not escalate
todo.nextAction: Author the golden set before any model wiring

intents.original: ye ek college major project hai toh over engineered nahi hona chahiye kuch
intents.summary: Prefer the smallest thing that works and demos well; reject speculative architecture.
acceptance: No MCP layer, no microservices, no separate REST API alongside Server Actions

intents.original: Development aur deployment free hona chahiye
intents.summary: Every tool and hosting tier must be free and require no credit card.
acceptance: Vercel Hobby, Neon free, Groq free, Better Auth self-hosted

intents.original: warm, youth-focused mental-health platform with a clean, friendly, editorial UI
intents.summary: Warm pastel editorial design in the spirit of most.org.au; never clinical, never a generic SaaS template.
acceptance: No purple gradients, glassmorphism or generic feature-card grids

intents.original: Apne apne chatbot ka name change karne ki freedom de skte hai
intents.summary: The student renames the companion; MAX is only the default name.
acceptance: Companion name and tone are set at onboarding and editable later

intents.original: Me chote models se development karunga toh unka kaam tumhe asaan karna hai
intents.summary: Small models implement from briefs; planning and judgement happen before the brief is written.
acceptance: Every brief names exact files, the full Zod schema, acceptance and a verify command

intents.original: especially in rural and semi-urban colleges
intents.summary: Low bandwidth and budget Android are graded requirements. Hindi UI was dropped by the owner on 2026-08-30; Hinglish input detection in the safety layer stays.
acceptance: Safety classifier covers Hindi and romanised Hinglish input

intents.original: Hindi + English drop kr diya tha sirf english rahega
intents.summary: The interface ships in English only. Bilingual UI is out of scope.
acceptance: No i18n framework in the dependency tree
Safety classifier still detects Hindi and Hinglish crisis input
